nikhanati1 (and nikhaṇayati ?), pr. 3 sg. [cf kāṇeti and S. nikāṇam], closes (the eye); winks; Vin III 53,.13 (nimittaṃ karoti akkhiṃ vā ~issāmi bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipissāmi …, Be, Ee so; Ce nikhanissāmi; Se nikkhanissāmi) = 78,.30 (Be, Ce so; Ee nikhanissāmi; Se nikkhanissāmi); Ja V 434,.6 (akkhiṃ ~ati bhamukaṃ ukkhipati, Ce so; Be, Ee nikhanati; Se nikkhanati) ≠ Dhp-a IV 197,.9 (Be so; Ce, Se nikhanati; Ee akkhī nikhanati); Sp 540,.8 (akkhiṃ vā ~ati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikhanati); Pj II 457,.16 (yadāhaṃ akkhiṃ vā ~āmi bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipissāmi, Be, Se so; Ce nikhanissāmi; Ee nikkhipissāmi); — part.pr. nikhaṇiyamāna, mfn., Vin III 188,.34 (na sakkā hoti akkhiṃ vā ~iyamāne bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipiyamāne … passituṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be ~īyamāne; Se nikhaniyamāne; pass. acc. sg. or act. acc. pl.?) = IV 69,.2 (Ce, Ee so; Be ~īyamāne; Se nikhaniyamāne); — fpp nikhaṇitabba, mfn., Vin V 163,.25 (na akkhi ~itabbaṃ, Be, Ee so; Ee akkhiṃ; Se nikkhanitabbaṃ; Ce na akkhī ~itabbā).

2nikhaṇati
nikhanati2 (and nikkhaṇati nikkhanati), pr. 3 sg. [S. nikhanati], digs (something) into (the ground), buries; implants, erects; D II 127,.22 (yaṃ te Cunda sūkaramaddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ taṃ sobbhe ~āhi, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce nikhanāhi) = Ud 82,.13; Ja I 264,.10 (imaṃ rājānaṃ … galappamāṇe āvāṭe khaṇitvā … ~atha, Ce, Ee so; Be nikhanatha; Se nikkhaṇatha); III 417,.16 (sarīraṃ … bhūmiyaṃ ~āhī ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhanāhī ti); IV 46,16* (tam ajj’ ahaṃ ~issāmi sobbhe, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhanissāmi); Ap 94,.26 (mā no jāti pabhijjī ti ~issanti khattiyā); Sp 341,.7 (dārūni ~ati, Be so; Ce, Se nikhanati; Ee ~āti); 1199,.21 (rukkhaṃ … nahānatitthe ~ati, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se nikkhananti); — fut. 2 sg. nikhaññasi (and nighaññasi?) [cf āhañchaṃ, āhañhi, āhaññiṃ sv āhanati?], Cp-a 225,15* (Kāsirañño ahaṃ putto yaṃ kāsuyā nikhaññasi, eds so) quoting Ja VI 13,18* (Be, Se nihaññasi; Ce, Ee nighaññasi; 13,27´ : nihaññasī ti nihanissasi, Be, Se so; Ce nighaññasī ti; Ee nighaññasī ti nikhaṇissasi); — part.pr. nikhaṇa(t), mfn.,? Ja VI 12,25* (so ’mhi raññā samajjhiṭṭho puttaṃ me ~aṃ vane, Be, Ce so; Ee samijjhiṭṭho; Se samijjhittho … nikkhanaṃ; part.pr. with cond./opt. sense, so T. Oberlies, 1991, pp. 121–22; or < opt. *nighane, see BSU § 230, K.R. Norman, 1981b, p. 164; Ja VI 12,28´ : ~aṃ vane ti vane ~eyyāsi, Be, Ce so; Se nikkhaneyyāsi; Ee vane ~anto) quoted Cp-a 224,28* (Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nikhanaṃ); Ja VI 12,31* (adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā maṃ ce tvaṃ ~aṃ vane, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhanaṃ; 13,5´ : maṃ vane ~eyyāsi adhammaṃ kareyyāsī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee nikhaneyyāsi; Se nikkhaneyyāsi); — aor. 3 sg. nikhaṇī, nikhani, Ja III 420,.5 (so … imasmiṃ ṭhāne tava pitaraṃ māretvā ~ī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee nikhanī ti; Se nikkhanī ti); Cp 3:14:4 (kāsuyā ~ī mamaṃ); 3 pl. nikhaṇiṃsu, Spk II 108,.12; — inf. (a) nikhātuṃ, Cp 3:6:16 (sārathī khaṇatī kāsuṃ nikhātuṃ paṭhaviyā mamaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhātuṃ); (b) nikhaṇituṃ, nikhanituṃ, Ja VI 11,.3 (Kāsirājā taṃ sve āmakasusāne ~ituṃ āṇāpesi, Be, Ce so; Ee nikhanituṃ; Se nikkhanituṃ); Cp-a 223,.29 (nikhātun ti ~ituṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nikhanituṃ); — absol. nikhaṇitvā, nikhanitvā, Vin II 116,.8 (khīlaṃ ~itvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nikhanitvā); D II 127,.28 = Ud 82,.18; M III 132,.23 (mahantaṃ thambhaṃ paṭhaviyaṃ ~itvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhanitva); Ud 44,.10 (naṃ jīvitā voropetvā … parikhākūpe ~itvā, Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhaṇitvā; Be nikkhipitvā) ≠ Pj II 519,.4 (parikhātaṭe ~itvā, Ee so; Ce nikhanitvā; Be, Se nikkhipitvā); Ja III 417,.27 (Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhanitvā); Vism 269,.3 (Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikhanitvā); Cp-a 222,.21 (āmakasusāne bhūmiyaṃ ~itvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nikkhanitvā); Sp 1199,.17 (nahānatitthe ~itvā ṭhapitatthambhe, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se nikkhanitvā); 1207,.16 (udake cattāro khāṇuke ~itvā, Be so; Ce nikhanitvā; Ee nikkhaṇitvā; Se nikkhanitvā); Sv 84,.28 (ekaccesu kira janapadesu kālakate ñātake na jhāpenti ~itvā ṭhapenti); — pass. part.pr. nikhaññamāna, mfn., Vism 302,.14; —     pp     nikhāta,   mfn. [ts], dug in; buried; fixed in the ground; Vin III 47,.35 (bhaṇḍaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhittaṃ hoti ~aṃ paṭicchannaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se omits); D II 171,.1 (satta esikā ~ā ahesuṃ); Sn 28 (khīlā ~ā asampavedhī, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be khilā; perhaps read nikhatā mc with K.R. Norman 2001a, p. 159); Ja I 267,26´ (āvāṭe ~o, Be Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhāto); III 24,28* (tass’ esa mūlasmiṃ nidhī ~o adāyādo; 25,11´ : bhūmiṃ khaṇitvā ṭhapitattā ~o); Vism 636,.22 (~ā acalā pabbatarājasadisā sati); — anikhāta, mfn., not dug; — anikhātakūla, mfn., with natural, not steep, banks; Ja VI 109,27* (anikhātakūlā nadī; 110,7´ : agambhīratīrā); — sunikhāta, mfn., securely fixed in the ground; D III 133,.7 (indakhīlo … gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo …, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se sunikkhitto); S V 270,.12 (Migāramātupāsādo … sunikhāto; Spk III 258,.2 foll. : koṭṭetvā suṭṭhu ṭhapito, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nissaya-ṭhapito); 444,.24 (sunikhātattā); Ud-a 213,.17 (sakkāya-bhūmiyaṃ sunikhāte viparītadassanatthambhe); — caus. aor. 3 sg. nikhaṇāpesi, Cp-a 265,.29 (bodhisattaṃ gaṇhāpetvā āvāṭe nikhaṇāpesi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nikhanāpesi); 2 pl. nikhaṇāpayittha, Cp-a 266,.31 (tumhe … nikhaṇāpayitthā ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nikhanāpayitthā ti); — absol. nikhaṇāpetvā, Ja IV 215,.8 (silāthambhaṃ nikhaṇāpetvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nikkhaṇāpetvā); Ud-a 400,.15 (Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nikhanāpetvā); Dhp-a III 67,.10 (Be, Ce so; Ee khanāpetvā; Se nikkhanāpetva) = Ap-a 242,.11 (Be, Ee so; Ce, Se nikhanāpetvā).
puñjati:
puñchati
(and, esp. in Ee puñjati1), pr. 3 sg. [cf S. proñchati], wipes; wipes away; wipes clean; A IV 376,.1 foll. (rajoharaṇaṃ suciṃ pi ~ati asuciṃ pi ~ati gūthagataṃ pi ~ati …); Sp 445,.7 (lohitakaṃ asiṃ vā sattiṃ vā ~issāmī ti); 1297,.15 (rajoharaṇaṃ karissāmā ti udakena temetvā pīḷetvā parikammakatabhūmiṃ ~issāma); Spk II 222,.3 (gattato udakaṃ ca ~ati); It-a I 49,.29 (so udakapuñchanaṃ viya nahātassa sarīragataṃ udakaṃ paresaṃ guṇe makkheti ~ati vināseti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee udakapuñjanī … puñjati …); Th-a III 84,.25 (paresaṃ vijjamāne guṇe makkhanti ~anti, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se puñjanti); 191,.30 (yathā yathā paresaṃ guṇe makkheti tathā tathā attano guṇe ~ati, nirākarotī ti nāma, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se puñjati); — part.pr. (a) puñchanta, mf (~antī) n., Vin II 210,.28 (upāhanā ~antena paṭhamaṃ sukkhena colakena ~itabbā pacchā allena); Ja IV 386,.25 (paṃsuṃ ~anto); V 137,.16 (udakatheve ~anto, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee puñjanto); 182,.8 (assūni puñjantī, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se muñcantī); Spk II 394,.27 (itthiyo … sarīraṃ ~antiyo); — neg. apuñchanta, mfn., Sp 1282,.9; (b) puñchamāna, mfn., Ja I 47,.25 (rudammukhā assūni hatthehi ~amānā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee puñjamānā) = Vism 415,.19; Ja I 243,.19 (sedaṃ ~amāno aṭṭhāsi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee muñcamāno); — aor. 3 sg. puñchi, Ja I 118,.9 (parisuddhena sāṭakena nalāṭantaṃ ~i, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee puñji) ≠ Dhp-a I 247,.5; — absol. puñchitvā, Vin I 345,.30 (kanditvā roditvā vappaṃ ~itvā); Ja I 318,.5 (akkhīni ~itvā ~itvā avigataniddo va, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee puñjitvā puñjitvā); 353,.23 (Illīsassa mukhaṃ ~itvā udakena siñciṃsu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee puñjitvā); III 41,.27 (bodhisattassa sarīrato lohitaṃ ~itvā); VI 63,.5 (taṃ maṃsakhaṇḍaṃ ādāya ~itvā patte katvā); 514,.17 (Maddī mahāsattassa pādesu rajaṃ ~itvā pāde sambāhetvā, Be, Ee so; Ee, Se puñjitvā); Sp 563,.15 (pattaṃ gahetvā telena ~itvā); Ps II 86,.4 (migaluddako … sākhābhaṅgena sarīraṃ ~itvā manussagandhaṃ apanetvā); Mhv 37:199 (~itvā morapiñjena); — pass. part.pr. puñchiyamāna, mfn., Sp 1363,.22 (rajoharaṇassa saṅkiliṭṭhe vā asaṅkiliṭṭhe vā pāde ~iyamāne n’ eva rogo na doso); — fpp puñchitabba, mfn., Vin II 208,.16 (upāhanapuñchanacolakaṃ pucchitvā upāhanā ~itabbā); Sp 1201,.6 (hatthaṃ temetvā sīsaṃ ~itabbaṃ); Vin-vn 2791; — caus. absol. puñchāpetvā, Vism 63,.3 (gabbhamālaṃ ~āpetvā).

2puñjati
pr. 3 sg. [cf S. puñjayati], heaps up; Sadd 350,.2 (puji rāsikaraṇe); — puñjati in Ee at Th-a II 248,.1 is wr; read saṅkārapuñjā ti saṅkārānaṃ ~aṃ saṅkārapuñjaṃ, tato kacavaraṭṭhānā with Be, Ce, Se; — absol. puñjitvā,? Ja II 398,.3 (hatthehi madditvā ~itvā vippakirissāmi nan ti, Be, Ee so; Ce puñchitvā; Se phusitvā); — see also opuñjati2.
uru:
1uru
mfn. [ts], wide, spacious; great; Abh 701; Mil 354,.26 (in long cpd : -uruvisaṭavitthata-); — see also abbhutoruguṇākara (sv abbhuta1), ubbī.

2uru
f. [?], sand; Abh 663; Sp 952,.13 (~ū ti vālikā vuccati) = Ps II 173,.5.

3uru
in Ee, Se at S II 258,.3 foll. (urūhi … urūsu), and in Ee at Ja V 303,21´ (urūsu) and Ja VI 566,.23 (urūsu) is wr for ūru (Be, Ce so).
ābhujana:
1ābhujana
n. [from ābhujati1], bending; — ifc see pallaṅk’-.

2ābhujana
ābhuñjana n. [from ābhujati2], especial concentration; As 334,.2 (vāyodhātum eva pana ābhujati, evaṃ °-vasena ārammaṇaṃ karoti nāma, Se so; Ee ābhuñjana-; Be ābhujita-; Ce ābhuñjita-); Vibh-a 405,.4 (tass’ eva [bhavaṅgassa] ~ato ābhogo).
abbhocchinna:
abbocchinna
(sometimes misspelt abbhocchinna), mfn. [neg. pp of vocchijjati; S. avyavacchinna], uninterrupted; unbroken; D III 105,.16 (purisassa ca viññāṇasotaṃ pajānāti ubhayato ~aṃ); Mil 72,.30 (~āya santatiyā); Nidd-a II 73,.31 (~assa sabbakāle vijjamānassa); — acc. ~aṃ, adv., uninterruptedly; Ap 89,.20 (aṭṭhakappāni devesu ~aṃ vasiṃ ahaṃ, Ce so; Ee abbhocchinnaṃ; Be abbokiṇṇaṃ; Se avokiṇṇaṃ); Vism 391,.12 (tayo māse ~aṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathesi).
abhibhūti:
abhibhūti
f. [ts], superior power; overpowering; Mhv 57:58.

abhigāmi(n)

abhinibbijjheyya

abhirucita

acchupeti:
acchupeti
pr. 3 sg. [caus. of *ā + chupati], inserts; puts on or in; Vin I 290,.2 foll. (yannūnāhaṃ aggaḷaṃ ~eyyaṃ … so bhikkhu aggaḷaṃ ~esi … addasa … taṃ bhikkhuṃ aggaḷaṃ ~entaṃ … aggaḷaṃ … ~emi; Sp 1128,.17 : aggaḷaṃ ~eyyan ti chinnaṭṭhāne pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ ṭhapeyyaṃ, Ee, Se so; Be chiddaṭṭhāne … laggāpeyyaṃ; Ce omits); — pass. 3 sg.? acchupī̆yati, Vin II 112,.36 (bahalāni [patta-]maṇḍalāni na ~īyanti … anujānāmi bhikkhave likhitun ti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~iyanti).
adhigammati:
adhigacchati
pr. 3 sg. [S. adhigacchati], gets to; attains, acquires; finds; understands; Vin I 228,.2 (mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ~ati); D I 224,.11 (samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ ~eyya); M I 275,.15 (~e somanassaṃ); S I 154,.18 (sa ce ratiṃ nādhigaccheyya tattha, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr nādhigacchaye) = Th 142; A I 162,29* (anupubbena nibbānaṃ ~anti paṇḍitā); Dhp 187 (api dibbesu kāmesu ratiṃ so nādhigacchati); It 82,8* (santim evādhigacchati); Thī 51 (attānaṃ ~a Ubbiri); Ja V 266,28* (nirayā nādhigacchanti dvāraṃ nikkhamanesino); Pv 7:4 (nibbutiṃ nādhigacchāmi); Ap 25,.25 (tuvaṃ pi ~ehi gacchāma buddhasantikaṃ, Ee, Se so; Be tvaṃ pi taṃ adhigacchesi; Ce tvaṃ pi taṃ ~āhi); — adhigacchati in Ee at Sv 921,.15 is wr for adhibhavati (Be, Ce, Se so); — fut. 3 sg. adhigamissati, M I 247,.12 (yaṃ no samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati taṃ no ārocessatī ti); 1 sg. (a) adhigamissāmi, Nidd II (Be) 228,.7 (cf Ee 131,.16); (b) adhigacchissāmi, Nidd I 67,.21 (~issāmi phusayissāmi); 3 pl. (a) adhigamissanti, Paṭis II 55,.23 (nekkhammaṃ … adhigatā vā ~anti vā adhigamissanti vā); (b) adhigacchissanti, Ps II 117,.24 (anvesantā pi kiṃ ~issanti); — part.pr. adhigacchanta, mf (~antī) n., It-a I 92,.23 (~antassa); Thī-a 249,.15 (mayā … ~antiyā); — neg. anadhigacchanta, mfn., Ja I 113,27´; Nidd I 440,.9; — aor 3 sg. (a) ajjhagamā, D III 170,2*; Sn 5 (yo nājjhagamā bhavesu sāraṃ); Ja III 450,22* (Udayo ajjhagamā mahattapattaṃ); — for ajjhagamā in eds at Vin III 147,22* = Ja II 285,23* and at Sn 379 read jagāma qv sv gacchati; (b) ajjhagacchi, ajjhagañchi, Ja V 255,19* (dīpaṃ so na ajjhagacchi agati yattha pakkhinaṃ, Ee so; Ce, Se ajjhagañchi; Be najjhagāgañchi; 256,23´ foll. attano patiṭṭhānaṃ na ajjhagacchī ti adhigañchī ti attho, Ee so; Ce na ajjhagañchi nādhigañchī ti; Se nādhigacchī ti; Be na ajjhagā nāgañchī ti); VI 202,23* (Ce, Ee ajjhagañchi; Be, Se ajjhagacchi); (c) adhigacchi, adhigañchi, D II 352,.1 (adhigacchi); Ja V 256,24´ (adhigañchī ti, Ee so; Ce nādhigañchī ti; Se nādhigacchī ti; Be nāgañchī ti); Ap-a 133,.3; — 2 sg. (a) ajjhagamā, M I 172,.9 (tvaṃ … nājjhagamā); (b) ajjhagamāsi, Ja V 171,8* (pucchāmi te nāgarāja tam atthaṃ kath’ ajjhagamāsi vimānaseṭṭhaṃ); — 1 sg. (a) ajjhagamaṃ, A I 259,.14 (yo loke assādo tad ajjhagamaṃ); Ap 49,.9 (bodhiṃ ajjhagamaṃ ahaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ajjhāgamaṃ); (b) ajjhagamiṃ, Th 117 (tisso vijjā ajjhagamiṃ); (c) adhigamiṃ, Pj II 393,.9; (d) adhigacchiṃ, D II 341,.19; Thī 221 (amataṃ ~iṃ); (e) adhigacchissaṃ, Sn 446 (satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ anubandhiṃ … otāraṃ nādhigacchissaṃ sambuddhassa satīmato; Pj II 393,.9 : nādhigacchissan ti nādhigamiṃ); — 3 pl. (a) ajjhagamaṃsu, M I 173,.11; (b) ajjhagamuṃ, S I 12,13* (pariyesamānā nājjhagamuṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nājjhāgamuṃ; perhaps read na ca ājagāmuṃ qv sv āgacchati); 22,7* (nibbānam ev’ ajjhagamuṃ sapaññā) = Ja III 473,2* (Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ajjhagamū); (c) ajjhagaṃsu, Ja II 296,11* (Ce, Ee so; Se ajjhaggaṃsu; Be ajjhagamuṃ); (d) adhigamiṃsu, Pj I 194,.11; (e) adhigacchiṃsu, Ja I 256,12´; — 1 pl. ajjhagamāmase, Ja VI 442,12*; —     part.perf.act.     adhigatava(t),   mfn., who has attained; Vv-a 296,.13 (nibbānam eva vā upagate, ~ante ti attho); — absol.
